blocks.name: cards
blocks.description: List of cards with optional image and body text.
blocks.decorate_shape: Converts block rows to <ul>/<li>. Per row, each child div is classed cards-card-image (if it holds only a picture) or cards-card-body. Rewrites images through createOptimizedPicture at 750px.
blocks.css_notes: grid auto-fill minmax(257px,1fr), gap 24px, 1px #dadada border per card, img aspect-ratio 4/3 object-fit cover.

blocks.name: columns
blocks.decorate_shape: Adds columns-N-cols class from first row's child count. Tags picture-only columns as columns-img-col so they order first on mobile.
blocks.example_markup:
| Columns |
| --- |
| col one content | col two content |
blocks.css_notes: Flex column on mobile; at >=900px flex row with flex:1 on every column (EQUAL widths only) and gap 24px.

blocks.name: hero
blocks.description: Hero treatment at the top of a page.
blocks.decorate_shape: NO JS AT ALL — hero.js is an empty file. Purely CSS over the default content flow (a picture plus an h1).
blocks.css_notes: position:relative, min-height 300px, padding 40/24. picture is absolutely positioned at inset:0 with z-index:-1 so it sits behind. h1 is max-width 1200px centred and coloured var(--background-color) (i.e. white-on-image).

blocks.name: header
blocks.decorate_shape: Loads the /nav fragment. Splits it into nav-brand / nav-sections / nav-tools. Builds a hamburger button below 900px, toggles aria-expanded on drop-down sections, closes on Escape and focus loss.
blocks.example_markup: Authored in a separate /nav document: a 3-section document (brand, sections, tools).
blocks.css_notes: Fixed-height nav, hamburger below 900px, hover/click dropdowns above 900px.

blocks.name: footer
blocks.decorate_shape: Loads the /footer fragment and appends its children into a single wrapper div. No structural decoration beyond that.
blocks.css_notes: Minimal — inherits default content flow styling.

blocks.name: fragment
blocks.decorate_shape: Fetches <path>.plain.html, decorates it as a main, rebases media URLs, returns the root. Utility block used by header/footer.
